Q1
Which exact part of this repo should change?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or prompt file — reply with the exact path or workflow name (for example: `.github/workflows/ai-clarify.yml` or `prompts/mode-clarify.txt`) (RECOMMENDED)
B. A shared script/helper under `scripts/` — reply with the exact path or function name
C. Documentation / README / workflow template files — reply with the exact file path(s)
D. I only know the pipeline phase so far — reply with which one (`clarify`, `plan`, `implement`, `review_autofix`, `orchestrate`, or `validate`)
Q2
What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug/regression — describe the current behavior and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change automation behavior — describe the exact new behavior wanted
C. Reduce noise, runtime, flakiness, or cost — name the symptom or metric to improve
D. Improve docs/onboarding/operator guidance — say what is confusing or missing
Q3
What concrete evidence or acceptance signal should planning use?
Choices:
A. Link one issue, PR, workflow run, or log snippet that shows the problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. Give a short before/after example of the desired behavior
C. Name the exact files, outputs, labels, comments, or workflow results that should change
D. I do not have a link/example, but I can provide the acceptance criteria in free text
